title: Arenal Lava & Forest Walk 2
description: Rainforest trails and cooled lava flows on the volcano's north flank, read out loud by a guide who grew up beneath it.
goodToKnow: Wear closed shoes; the trail includes uneven volcanic rock. Bring water and sun protection.
